label: Nokia G-010S-A GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98035, 64 MB RAM / 16 MB flash, OpenWRT) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-upc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over web UI + SSH + serial.
